LanguageData.TMM.Sales.ForSaleHelp: Sell this storage's contents to visitors. The entire storage must be inside the complex. Guests collect public goods themselves; staff with the Sales work enabled deliver from staff rooms. Prices are 55% of market value, matching normal Hospitality shopping. Silver appears at reception after delivery. No shopping area is required.
LanguageData.TMM.Sales.Outside: Sales inactive: storage is outside the complex.
LanguageData.TMM.Sales.StaffOnly: Staff-only storage: requires an employee with Sales work enabled.
